national_news.title: Swiss President Guy Parmelin Visits India for Bilateral Discussions & India-EFTA Summit
bullets: Swiss President Guy Parmelin arrived in New Delhi on a three-day state visit to review progress in bilateral trade, science, technology, and mobility with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The visit marks his participation in the 2nd India-EFTA Prosperity Summit, celebrating the 1st anniversary of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
Switzerland remains India's largest trade and investment partner among the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) member nations.

national_news.title: India Concludes 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in 4th Position with 85 Medals
bullets: India finished 4th in the overall medal tally at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, securing 85 medals (21 Gold, 27 Silver, and 37 Bronze).
India achieved a historic clean sweep of gold medals in men's and women's events across Cricket, Kabaddi, and Hockey, with both hockey teams earning direct qualification for the LA 2028 Olympics.
The women's hockey team won its first Asian Games gold medal in 44 years (since 1982) after defeating China 1-0.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Highlights New Avenues for Emerging and Middle Powers at Munich Security Conference Event
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar addressed the 62nd Munich Security Conference event in New Delhi, emphasizing supply chain resilience, connectivity, and peace as key agendas for Emerging and Middle Powers (EMPs).
He highlighted strategic multilateral forums and connectivity initiatives, including the Quad, BRICS, India-Middle East-Europe Connectivity Corridor (IMEC), INSTC, and the Northern Sea Route.
The Minister underscored expanding India-EU cooperation in advanced manufacturing, semiconductors, AI, space capabilities, and growing defence exports through domestic start-ups.

national_news.title: PM-SETU Scheme Completes One Year of Implementation
bullets: PM-SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) is implemented by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship with a total outlay of Rs 60,000 crore (Rs 30,000 crore Centre, Rs 20,000 crore States, and Rs 10,000 crore Industry).
The scheme aims to modernise Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs); 850 ITIs have been identified so far, comprising 172 Hub ITIs and 678 Spoke ITIs across 200 identified clusters.
Strategic Investment Plans for 14 ITI clusters have been approved under the National Steering Committee (NSC) with an investment exceeding Rs 3,446 crore.

national_news.title: All India Institute of Ayurveda Concludes Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA) observed the Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 campaign from September 17 to October 2 under the theme 'Swachhata Mein Sabhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat'.
The initiative integrated environmental sustainability drives including a plantation drive under the 'Ek Ped Ma Ke Naam' initiative.
Post-campaign activities continue under Special Campaign 6.0 until October 31 with a dedicated focus on the 'Effective Collection, Segregation and Disposal of e-waste'.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department Revises Essential Drug List to Enhance Treatment Access
bullets: The Bihar health department revised its Essential Drug List to include specialized medicines and medical devices for haemophilia, heart attacks, kidney disease, cervical cancer, and rabies.
Key additions include Factor VIII medicines, dialysis consumables, Pap smear kits, and Tenecteplase for heart attacks expanded to district hospitals and community health centres.
The initiative aims to improve healthcare accessibility in government hospitals and significantly reduce out-of-pocket expenses for poor and needy families.

bihar_news.title: RBI Considers Repo Rate Hike Amid Rising Crude Oil Prices and Inflation Risks
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) reviewed the policy repo rate, which currently stands at 5.25 percent.
Rising global crude oil prices due to West Asian tensions and retail inflation staying above the 4 percent target prompted considerations for a rate hike.
India's retail inflation rose to 4.82 percent in August, while real GDP growth for 2026-27 is projected at 6.7 percent or higher.

bihar_news.title: New Double-Line Rail Bridge Commissioned at Mokama over Ganges
bullets: A new Rs 2,400 crore double-line rail bridge over the Ganges at Mokama began operations with the crossing of the Mahananda Express.
The 1.86 km long bridge project was sanctioned in the 2015-16 Rail Budget and construction was launched by PM Narendra Modi in March 2016.
Built by Afcons Infrastructure under IRCON, the bridge is designed for speeds up to 140 kmph and doubles rail capacity across the river alongside the older Rajendra Setu.
